criteria.requirement: Add top-level/Table.convert_report(table,converters,errorvalue=None), eagerly consume source exactly once and return immutable replayable (table,issues) tuples. Validate converter callables and unique existing field names; retain header/order/other fields. Each failed field (including short-row access) gets replacement and ordered 1-based data row/field/error_type issue, never raw value or exception message. Report multiple errors per row, preserve successful conversions and support empty/one-shot sources. Existing lazy convert failure defaults remain unchanged; explicit snapshot memory semantics, not a streaming claim.

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
